label: Oxygen Not Included sandboxes
description: How Oxygen Not Included sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Mods live in the Mods folder of the game directory in the source extension's layout; the game also reads a Mods folder from the user's documents, which a sandbox does not manage.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
